statements.impact_statement: Ubuntu Noble's python3-mpmath package ships a backported ReDOS fix; Grype 0.118.0 reports synthetic 0.0.0 egg-info metadata, while the runtime package is the patched distro build.

Ubuntu Noble's nodejs package vendors @fastify/busboy for npm-internal use. Node is in this image only as a JavaScript runtime for tests/unit/test_dashboard_accessibility.py to evaluate the dashboard modules; no HTTP server, multipart parser or npm client is started in the image at run time, so the multipart part-header path this advisory needs is never executed.

virtualenv is a build-time tool pulled in by docker/requirements-dev.lock; the image never runs it. It is pinned rather than removed because the lock is hash-verified and resolved as a set, and because version drift there is what the lock exists to prevent. Upgrading it is tracked separately; this statement records why the finding cannot be reached in this image.

filelock arrives with the same build-time dependency set as virtualenv and is never imported by the daemons. The advisory concerns lock files created in a directory an attacker controls; the only lock files this image writes are under /opt/workbench-venv at build time.
